meaning.en: Producing, carrying, or powered by a single alternating voltage.

meaning.en: Powered either by a single AC voltage or current or by several equal AC voltages or currents that are either in phase or out of phase by one half a cycle (180°)

sentences.en: Where no three-phase electricity is available and single-phase motors are unsuitable, a single to three-phase converter may be the only answer.
